acoustic_schema: mean fraction of adjacent samples with differing signbit per frame
population std of frame zero crossing fraction
mean sqrt(power-weighted squared distance to centroid) / Nyquist
mean first frequency reaching 85 percent cumulative frame power / Nyquist
mean geometric/arithmetic frame power ratio; zero for zero-power frame
population std of frame spectral flatness
mean squared L2 change between successive normalized power spectra
1 if a decoded source audio stream supplies at least 0.25 second for window; else 0

acoustic_parameters.trailing_frame: zero pad to next complete frame
acoustic_parameters.normalization: PCM / 32768; no loudness normalization; standardization later fits training role only
acoustic_parameters.missing_audio: all 16 zeros with explicit audio_present=0; media errors are not silently converted to missing
